services.desc: Rent one of our uniquely curated rooms for a party, wedding, special event, or class. Choose our spacious ballroom for your wedding venue, reception area, birthday celebration, corporate event, retirement party, theater production, or concert. This turnkey space contains a stage, sound system, and updated lighting to personalize the look and feel of whatever you would like to host. Our beautiful 60's-era mahogany bar has plenty of room for all of your food and beverages. Includes use of two renovated bathrooms and kitchen area, perfect for catering/staging. blurb: We are a unique, bold, and alternative event and art space in Milton, Pennsylvania, dedicated to accessible and inclusive creativity. Experience numerous areas to host your party, wedding, corporate event, class, or workshop.
